refutes.statement: Conjecture BT (K4.HALL.BT): a Pareto-maximum inside the min-frozen class of 𝒫, with ω ≥ 1, that is not removal-only completable has a frozen big-top agent (four goods, holding its top a with a > b + c), or has no frozen agent and a label collision (K4.HALL.H0 (b)). Restated in k4/hall_bt.md §1: if P has ω ≥ 1, no removal-only owner, and frozen agents, then some frozen big-top agent is exposed w.r.t. some free owner

A frozen agent that is not big-top (exposed only locally) is repaired by the exchange cycle through the owner, as by Theorem K3's cycle move at k = 3; i.e. some cycle of #41's exchange digraph through an exposed frozen agent completes P (k4/hall_bt.md §1: 'At k = 4 it is not enough'; at bt4 no such cycle completes P, only a downgrade swap, which is not an exchange-digraph cycle)

notes: Values are good:value as in bt4.inst. P: bases B_0={2,5} (free, needs 6), B_1={0,3} (free, needs 4), B_2={4} (frozen), B_3={6} (frozen); J={1}; no slots; ω=1; fewest frozen = 2. Agent 0 is big-top (10 > 6+3) but free; agents 1-3 are not big-top. P is Pareto-maximal among all 24 valid pre-allocations and not completable: owner 0: B_0 ∪ J = {2,5,1} gives agent 2 goods 1,2 worth 14 > 10; owner 1: {0,3,1} gives agent 3 goods 1,3 worth 10 > 8. Repair (downgrade swap, deficit −2): agent 1 takes 4, agent 2 takes {1}, {0,3} becomes junk. Found in the sample results/k4_hall_bt_samples.log (1 of the 303 pure n = 4 maxima there that are not removal-only completable); BT holds for all n ≤ 3 (exhaustive) and vacuously at n = 4 with one 4-good agent; m = 7 not claimed minimal ('smallest failing configuration found').
